title: Great People, Great Place to Work: Lowe’s Earns Third Consecutive Certification
summary: Great People, Great Place to Work: Lowe’s Earns Third Consecutive Certification
body_markdown:
For the third year running, Lowe’s has earned the title of Great Place to Work in the U.S., a recognition shaped by the voices of those who know its culture best: the associates.


This year, 78% of surveyed associates called Lowe’s a great place to work, far outpacing the national average. The Great Place to Work survey looks at what matters most: pride, camaraderie, credibility, respect and fairness.


Behind every number are stories of associates building careers, growing as leaders and helping Lowe’s succeed.


“The way we treat our associates is why we're so successful and able to meet our bottom line and our goals,” said Mary Beth Vida, manager of supply chain operations in Pittston, Virginia.


For Lynn Carle, senior manager of supply chain operations in Pittston, one of the most rewarding parts is seeing


that growth


firsthand.


“Watching our associates develop and our leaders grow into their aspirations is the most amazing part of this job,” Carle said.
